name: United Arab Emirates
intro: Experience a futuristic oasis where heritage meets architectural marvels. From the soaring heights of the Burj Khalifa to luxury desert camps under the stars, Dubai is a playground of modern global luxury.
weather: Hot desert climate. Pleasant warm winters (20°C to 30°C), scorching dry summers (40°C+) where indoor malls are preferred.
visaInfo: Visa required prior to travel for Indian passport holders (obtainable as eVisa).
flightDuration: Approx 3-4 hours direct flight from Mumbai or Delhi.
highlights: Ascend the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa
Embark on a vintage 4x4 desert safari over golden dunes
Discover the luxurious resorts on the palm-shaped island of Palm Jumeirah
Shop at the massive Dubai Mall and watch the choreographed fountain shows

famousPlaces.name: Burj Khalifa & Downtown
famousPlaces.shortDesc: The crown jewel of Dubai's skyline, standing as the tallest structure in human history with observation decks.
famousPlaces.overview: Burj Khalifa dominates the skyline of Downtown Dubai, rising 828 meters. A masterwork of engineering, it sits beside the Dubai Mall and the spectacular Dubai Fountain. Visitors can ascend to the 124th and 148th floors to view the city, desert, and ocean.

hotels.name: Armani Hotel Dubai
hotels.description: Exquisite designer hotel located inside the Burj Khalifa itself with private entrance.

hotels.name: The Palace Downtown
hotels.description: Arabian-style hotel overlooking the Dubai Fountain and Burj Lake.

famousPlaces.meals: International breakfasts and high tea at Atmosphere restaurant.
famousPlaces.transport: Luxury private airport transfers and downtown monorail tickets.
famousPlaces.activities: Burj Khalifa 148th Floor Access, Dubai Fountain Lake Ride, Dubai Mall Shopping Guide.

faqs.q: What is the best time to see the fountains?
faqs.a: The Fountain shows run every 30 minutes in the evening starting from 6:00 PM.

reviews.author: Karan S.
reviews.text: Standing on the 148th floor looking down at skyscrapers that felt like miniature toys was surreal.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Fountain Show View
itinerary.morning: Arrive in Dubai. VIP transfer to Armani Hotel.
itinerary.afternoon: Stroll inside the massive Dubai Mall and visit the giant indoor aquarium.
itinerary.evening: Watch the fountain show from your private dinner table at Palace Downtown.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa Summit & Skyline Dine
itinerary.morning: Ascend to 'At The Top Sky' observatory on the 148th floor.
itinerary.afternoon: Gourmet lunch at Atmosphere restaurant inside the Burj.
itinerary.evening: Desert sunset photography excursion with private 4x4 car.
